changed.item: Crowd Focus claim lost its hedge: the original says it 'helps your hearing aids bring the voice in front of you forward'; the edit says it 'brings the voice of the person in front of you forward', which states the benefit more firmly
Crowd Focus benefit narrowed from 'the people you're talking with' (plural, conversational group) to a single 'person in front of you'
Timing framing: the original says the update is 'coming'; the edit's 'We're rolling out' could suggest it is already available, though the October 20 start date is kept later
